name: Secret Garden
source:
You wake up in a garden, unable to remember what happened. but you receive an invitation to a tea party—set to take place in seven days.

[From [url=https://deliygarden.itch.io/secret-garden]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在花园里醒来，不记得发生了什么。但是你收到了一份茶会邀请函，该茶会将于7天内举行。

[来自[url=https://deliygarden.itch.io/secret-garden]itch.io[/url]]
